how_to_read: One card per currency or item. `verified` true means the use and the sources rest on a cited page or on the project's own reward data. `basis` on best_use and do_not: 'experience' is the author's judgement as a player, 'source' is taken from a cited page. null in `numbers` means the value was not verified and must not be printed. `paid_sources` are Feh Pass or shop sources and must be shown apart from free ones (plan decision 9).
not_covered: event tickets such as Battle Flags, Forma Torches and Conquest Lances

cards.name: Orbs
cards.what: Pay for summoning. Also accepted for stamina, Arena tries, revives, castle upgrades and barracks space.
from: Story maps and Paralogues, first clear per difficulty (once)
Arena: 1 orb for the first win of each season, more in the tier reward

best_use.text: Summoning, on a banner where you can reach the free pick or where one color holds several heroes you lack.

do_not.text: Do not pay orbs for stamina, Dueling Swords or a revive. Each has a free item.

cards.paid_sources: Feh Pass quests: 5 orbs on the 10th and 25th (wiki, 2022; the November 2026 quest data shows two sets of 5).

do_not.text: Do not promote a hero just to pass on one skill unless the skill needs 5 stars.

cards.name: Dragonflowers
cards.what: Add stats to a hero. One kind per movement type: (I) infantry, (A) armored, (C) cavalry, (F) flying. Five steps give +1 to every stat. They do not count for Arena scoring or matchmaking.
from: Heroic Ordeals: one map for every hero you own (once per hero)
Aether Raids: tier and rank rewards every week
Quests (40 Dragonflowers (I) in the November 2026 quests)

best_use.text: The first five steps on each hero of your main teams: they are the cheapest and give +1 to all stats.

do_not.text: Do not pour them into a hero you field in one mode only.

cards.name: Blessings
cards.what: Confer an element on a hero (not on Legendary, Mythic or Chosen heroes). A blessed hero gets double SP, and stat boosts in the blessing's season when a matching Legendary or Mythic hero is on the team. Eight kinds: Fire, Water, Wind, Earth (Legendary), Light, Dark, Astra, Anima (Mythic). A blessing cannot be taken back; a new one overwrites the old.
from: One with every Legendary or Mythic hero you summon
Aether Raids: Light or Dark and Astra or Anima blessings for playing on the first and fifth day of a season
Blessed Gardens, first clear: Fire, Water, Wind, Earth
Legendary and Mythic Hero Battles, first clear of the lowest difficulty

best_use.text: Bless the heroes that fight beside your Legendary and Mythic heroes in the same season.

do_not.text: Do not bless a hero without owning a Legendary or Mythic hero of that element.
